name: Paychex
description: Paychex sells payroll, HR, benefits and retirement software and outsourcing to small and mid-sized US employers, charging per employee per pay period. Its PEO and insurance line co-employs worksite employees and sells workers comp and health insurance, and it earns interest on client funds it holds. The April 2025 Paycor acquisition added mid-market software, lifting FY2026 revenue 17 percent, and its financing pushed interest expense to $269.5 million from $105.4 million. Paychex reports a single segment and uses net income as its profit measure.

hq.note: Dual headquarters in Rochester, NY and Cincinnati, OH per 10-K

businessLines.name: Management Solutions
businessLines.how: Per-employee-per-pay-period fees for payroll, HR software and retirement/time products, plus HR outsourcing (ASO); grew 20% on the Paycor acquisition.

businessLines.name: PEO and Insurance Solutions
businessLines.how: Fee per PEO worksite employee for co-employment, plus revenue from insurance products sold to clients; grew 7%.

businessLines.name: Interest on funds held for clients
businessLines.how: Interest earned investing client payroll and tax money between collection and payout; up 30% in FY2026.

brands.name: Paycor
brands.note: Acquired April 2025; contributed about 12% to total revenue growth and about 15% to Management Solutions revenue growth in FY2026

profileAgainst: 10-K FY2026 (filed 2026-07-17); 10-Q for quarter ended 2026-08-31 (filed 2026-09-24) not read
